result.topic_en: Draft of §16 of Riemann's dissertation on the Dirichlet principle: showing that the conditions imposed on the function σ determine ω only up to a constant, by computing the change in the integral Ω when σ is varied by σ', followed by remarks on extending the considerations to a finite region and to multi-sheeted surfaces.
